name: bán síde
text: bán síde is the Old-Irish spelling of the headword banshee. MacKillop prints the form as bán side, without the fada on the s. The full record of the banshee word-article sits under the headword banshee.

attributes.attribute: Old-Irish spelling of the headword banshee.

okr.objective: bán síde is an Old-Irish spelling signpost pointing to the banshee node.
key_results: Signpost cites the headword banshee for the full record of the article.
